comparison.objective: Select one M4×20 screw from alternatives and hand it into a tray; candidate commissions a robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Visual size selection, singulation, and small-part handoff versus recessed-key insertion, bimanual stabilization, fine collar adjustment, locking, and dynamic evaluation.
comparison.success_condition: Exactly one correct screw rests within 4 mm of the tray floor versus two safe repeated stops and post-lock retention under witness torque.
comparison.reason: Different objective, physical mechanism, and success condition. No spec versions were provided; the body supplies the main screw and tray criteria.
